review:
Power of Ten is a salon-themed paylines slot centred on Power Wheels and a 10,000x max win. A Power Wheel waits until line wins are paid, then spins to award 10x, 100x, 1,000x or the max win; several wheels add their values together.

Five Power Wheels in a row on the same line raise every wheel's possible values to 100x, 1,000x or the max win, and a max win result ends the round immediately. The High-Roller FeatureSpins mode lands only Power Arrow symbols for a direct shot at the max win. Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP or volatility outside the game.
